title: WWII Soldier POV: D-Day at Omaha Beach
hook: You are inside the landing craft. The ramp is about to drop.
shortDescription: Experience D-Day from the first-person perspective of a fictional U.S. infantry soldier landing on Omaha Beach on June 6, 1944. Cinematic historical reenactment, not archival footage.
longDescription: Step into an immersive first-person historical reenactment of the D-Day assault on Omaha Beach, June 6, 1944. This episode follows a fictional composite U.S. infantry soldier from the landing craft, through the surf and beach obstacles, toward the bluffs and the first fragile foothold inland. The visual story is inspired by documented battlefield conditions and period equipment while avoiding graphic imagery and invented famous quotations. This is an AI-generated cinematic reenactment, not real wartime footage.
disclosure: AI-generated cinematic historical reenactment. Not archival footage.
audience: Global history, military history and cinematic POV audiences
